title: Pricing Snowsports School Bookings Made Together by One Household
content:
Bookings made together by one household are priced as a group. This page carries the Snowsports School basis on which that group is judged and on which the reductions are taken.

## 1. The group reduction

Where the household books the same product for two or more participants starting on the same date — a group standing at 2 participants at the least — the multi-booking reduction published for that product is taken off every one of those bookings.

## 2. Children of one household

Where the participants are children of one household, the sibling reduction published for that product is taken off the second and each further child instead of the multi-booking reduction, whichever of the two is the larger; the two are never taken together.

## 3. Order in which the reductions act

The season passholder reduction, where the product carries one, is taken first, and the group reduction is worked out on the figure it leaves.

## 4. When the group is judged

Bookings made on different days are not grouped after the fact, because the group is judged at the moment the tuition is raised.

## 5. The same basis put as a set of readings

| Situation | Which reduction is taken |
| --- | --- |
| one participant booked on a date | no group reduction is taken, the group standing below 2 participants |
| two participants of a household, not children of it, booked into the same product on the same date | the multi-booking reduction for that product, off both bookings |
| three children of one household booked into the same product on the same date, the sibling reduction standing above the multi-booking reduction | the sibling reduction off the second and the third child |
| three children of one household booked into the same product on the same date, the multi-booking reduction standing above the sibling reduction | the multi-booking reduction, off every one of the three bookings |
| two participants booked into the same product for the same date but on different days | no group reduction, the bookings not being grouped after the fact |

The multi-booking rate, the sibling rate and whether a product carries a passholder reduction at all are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
